$comment: Fieldstone Labs (plugin-debug's Fieldstone sample space) scopes the task 'Ship the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin'. Astrid is the local user; the others are simulated participants. heygen.mjs generates each participant from `prompt` and records the look in <out>/cast.json unless a participant sets avatarId.

astrid.name: Astrid Holm
astrid.prompt: Woman in her mid 20s, Scandinavian, short dark bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, cream knit sweater, big warm smile, clearly enjoying the conversation. Sitting in a cozy busy coffee shop, espresso machine and warm bokeh lights behind her, latte cup on the table. Daylight from the window. Video call webcam framing: medium close-up from a laptop camera at eye level, looking straight into the camera, head, shoulders and hands visible. Natural matte skin, realistic, no retouching, 35mm lens.
astrid.motion: Talking warmly on a video call, relaxed, smiling, an occasional small hand gesture.

lucia.name: Lucía Ferreira
lucia.prompt: Woman in her mid 20s, Latina, long dark wavy hair, thin gold-rimmed glasses, mustard cardigan over a white tee, laughing, lively and animated. Sitting outside on a park bench, green trees and a path behind her, bright sunny afternoon. Video call webcam framing: medium close-up from a laptop camera at eye level, looking straight into the camera, head, shoulders and hands visible. Natural matte skin, realistic, no retouching, 35mm lens.
lucia.motion: Animated and enthusiastic on a video call: expressive hand gestures, open palms, counting on her fingers, laughing, leaning in.

ben.name: Ben Achterberg
ben.prompt: Japanese man in his mid 20s, short black hair, black rectangular glasses, charcoal hoodie, grinning, relaxed and having fun. Late at night in his small Tokyo apartment: the room is dark, lit only by a warm desk lamp and the cool glow of his monitor on his face; a large window behind him shows a dark night sky and glittering city lights and neon. Video call webcam framing: medium close-up from a laptop camera at eye level, looking straight into the camera, head, shoulders and hands visible. Natural matte skin, realistic, no retouching, 35mm lens.
ben.motion: Relaxed and cheerful on a video call, grinning, a light shrug and a small gesture toward the screen.

tomas.name: Tomás Vidal
tomas.prompt: Man in his late 20s, Spanish, short curly hair and short trimmed beard, clear-framed glasses, light blue denim shirt, smiling broadly, cheerful. Bright modern co-working space, whiteboard with sketches and plants behind him, daylight. Video call webcam framing: medium close-up from a laptop camera at eye level, looking straight into the camera, head, shoulders and hands visible. Natural matte skin, realistic, no retouching, 35mm lens.
tomas.motion: Upbeat on a video call, nodding while he talks, one confident hand gesture.

lines.speaker: astrid
lines.text: Thanks for jumping on. Today we scope the Cairn dashboard as a Composer plugin. Lucía, what do customers need first?

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Cache hit rate per repo, and which builds missed. Okapi asked for exactly that twice last month.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I sketched it as a plank: a hit-rate chart across the top, and a table of recent builds underneath.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: The table can be a live query over build records, so it updates the moment Builder pushes a run.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Can we flag the slowest misses? That's the conversation we want to have with customers.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Sure. A red badge on any miss over a minute, linking straight to its trace.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I'll have Builder draft the query, and I can show a first cut in storybook on Thursday.

lines.speaker: astrid
lines.text: Great. Ben shares the sketch today, Tomás builds the plank, and Lucía checks it with Okapi. Thanks, everyone.
